name: partial_measurement
description: Only some qubits measured, into a different classical bit.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure(1, 0)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.measure(q[1], key="c0"),
)
